description: What the live-runner suite must notice: a gate that no longer refuses (the owner's yes, the sandbox, the budget, the price, the key), more than one key variable reaching the Hub, a key outside the allow-list, a model without tool calling let through, approvals answered yes, a stopped task not cancelled or the run going on after a budget stop, rates that undercount, and the redactor of the output. The governor's own stop rules, limits and ledger are in live-budget.json.

mutations.name: L01-no-ok-gate
mutations.what: CHATMCP_LIVE_OK is not checked

mutations.name: L02-loose-ok-gate
mutations.what: any non-empty CHATMCP_LIVE_OK opens the gate

mutations.name: L03-no-sandbox-gate
mutations.what: a run without a sandbox marker is not refused

mutations.name: L04-loose-ci
mutations.what: any CI value counts as a sandbox

mutations.name: L05-loose-sandbox-variable
mutations.what: any CHATMCP_LIVE_SANDBOX value counts as a sandbox

mutations.name: L06-no-dockerenv
mutations.what: /.dockerenv is not looked at

mutations.name: L07-budget-optional
mutations.what: --budget-usd is not required

mutations.name: L08-zero-budget
mutations.what: a budget of 0 is accepted

mutations.name: L09-provider-optional
mutations.what: --provider is not required

mutations.name: L10-unknown-price-allowed
mutations.what: a provider without an output price is accepted

mutations.name: L11-runner-allow-list
mutations.what: the runner's own check of the entry's key variable against the allow-list is removed
mutations.equivalent: defence in depth: forwardedKey() in tests/live/lib/session.mjs refuses the same variable a few lines later, before any process starts, and the refusal still exits 2 (L12 tests that check)

mutations.name: L12-session-allow-list
mutations.what: a key variable outside the allow-list is forwarded

mutations.name: L13-forward-everything
mutations.what: the whole caller environment is forwarded with the key

mutations.name: L14-empty-key
mutations.what: an empty key variable is accepted

mutations.name: L15-no-tool-calling-check
mutations.what: the result of the tool-calling check is ignored

mutations.name: L16-approve
mutations.what: the approvals Full Access still asks for are answered yes

mutations.name: L17-no-full-access
mutations.what: the run stays in the default permission mode

mutations.name: L18-no-cancel
mutations.what: a stopped task is not cancelled (the Hub client reports a cancel it never sent)

mutations.name: L19-no-run-stop
mutations.what: the run goes on to the next task after a budget stop

mutations.name: L26-base-tier
mutations.what: the base price is used even when the provider has a dearer tier

patches.old: for (const tier of tiers) if (tier.input >= chosen.input && tier.output >= chosen.output) chosen = tier;

mutations.name: L27-cache-read-discount
mutations.what: the cache-read discount is given to the ledger

patches.old: const result = { input: chosen.input, output: chosen.output };
patches.new: const result = { input: chosen.input, output: chosen.output, ...(typeof chosen.cacheRead === 'number' ? { cacheRead: chosen.cacheRead } : {}) };

mutations.name: L28-cache-write-discount
mutations.what: a cache-write rate below the input rate is given to the ledger

mutations.name: L29-no-redaction
mutations.what: the key value is not redacted from messages and the report

mutations.name: L30-profile-without-rates
mutations.what: the profile carries no rates

mutations.name: L31-profile-not-default
mutations.what: the profile is not made the default
mutations.equivalent: the runner's Hub starts with an empty state folder, and AiProfileStore.upsert makes the first profile the default whatever isDefault says (`!this.defaultProfileId || input.isDefault`); the flag matters only for a Hub that already has a profile

mutations.name: L32-step-cap
mutations.what: a task above the runner's step cap is accepted

mutations.name: L33-path-escape
mutations.what: a task file with .. in its path is accepted
